Fusion Claw and AI Agent Studio in Oracle Fusion 26D

Only the What's New rows we can verify as Fusion Claw or AI Agent Studio. Nothing else is added to make the list look complete.

In short: Fusion Updates lists only What's New rows whose Oracle title, module, or feature-summary tag says Fusion Claw or AI Agent Studio. In the current 26D extract that is 1 row: Simulate award scenarios in the Sourcing Command Center. None of those 26D titles is "AI Agent Studio". Earlier releases we track include 4 AI Agent Studio rows, linked below. Other AI agents and agentic apps are not listed here. We do not publish AI-unit budgets or guardrail counts; those figures are not fields in our extract. Enablement is Oracle's Action to Enable column. Confirm each linked Oracle page in your test pod before production.

Oracle describes Fusion Claw in this Fusion Insider article. This page does not repeat counts from that article. The tables are rows already in our What's New extract. We recheck them every week.

Frequently asked questions

Does Fusion Updates list Fusion Claw in 26D?

The current 26D extract has 1 row whose feature-summary tag or title says Fusion Claw: Simulate award scenarios in the Sourcing Command Center. No 26D row is titled Fusion Claw. If Oracle adds another tagged row for a module we cover, the weekly refresh picks it up.

Does Fusion Updates list AI Agent Studio in 26D?

Not as a 26D Feature Summary title or tag in the modules we cover. Our extract does include 4 AI Agent Studio rows in earlier releases (26B, 26C). Open the linked Oracle page for any 26D Fusion Claw row to see whether that page also describes AI Agent Studio setup.

Why are other AI agents not on this page?

A title that merely says "assistant" or "agentic app" is not Fusion Claw or AI Agent Studio. Those features stay on the module pages. This page does not invent rows to fill a gap.

Where do the enablement labels come from?

Oracle's Action to Enable column, copied from the What's New row. We do not add AI-unit budgets or guardrail counts.
